create.name: Jordyn Roe
create.bio:
Jordyn Roe is a meditation guide and poet whose work centres on self-love and returning attention to the heart. She came to contemplative practice during a hard stretch of her own life, and her study of yoga, meditation and Reiki grew from that search. Her teaching weaves guided meditation together with breathwork, mantra, metta, mirror work, embodied movement and spoken poetry, and she often draws on the mystic poets, from Rumi to St John of the Cross and his dark night of the soul.

Her main offering is a self-paced online retreat, Revive the Voice of Self-Love, built around a week of recorded practices with journalling questions for reflection between sessions. She has also led live group meditations over video call, and she publishes free practices on her YouTube channel, including a two-part mirror work series, a chakra meditation, a guided ecstatic dance and meditations for couples. On her own site she writes about poetry as a spiritual practice and shares writing prompts for exploring the inner life. Her recorded meditations are free to hear on Insight Timer, where she lists her base as Florida.

courses.title: Revive The Voice of Love: Meditation & Self Reflection Retreat
courses.description: A self-paced online retreat spread over a week, with fourteen recorded practices that mix metta, mantra, breathwork, movement and mirror work. Journalling questions accompany each day so you can reflect on what comes up.

courses.title: Revive The Voice Of Self Love (Insight Timer course)
courses.description: A twelve-day audio course on Insight Timer in which Jordyn guides a daily practice of turning towards yourself with kindness. It shares its theme with her longer online retreat.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Jordyn Roe on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Jordyn's guided meditations and self-inquiry practices, some woven with her own poetry. They are free to listen to in the app or on the web.

free_resources.title: Holy Darkness: Poetry & Meditation
free_resources.description: A short essay on finding meaning in difficult seasons, paired with a spoken poem and a wordless guided sit. A gentle way into her blend of poetry and contemplative practice.

free_resources.title: Writing Prompts: Liberation through Creativity
free_resources.description: A set of journalling prompts on themes such as rain and darkness, each with a poem to spark your own writing. Useful as a creative companion to meditation.

flags: Her own about page and Insight Timer bio describe her personal history of depression (her story, not a sales claim), and the Teachable pages carry a testimonial mentioning panic/anxiety attacks; nothing is sold on conditions, but a human may want to confirm this passes the strict health rule.
Activity looks quiet: site footer says 2022, YouTube uploads are about 3 years old; the Teachable retreat is still for sale and the Teachable footer says 2026.
Retreat price differs: $88 on the retreat page, $66 on the Teachable home listing (possibly a sale); plan uses $88 USD.
The Insight Timer course and the Teachable retreat share a name and may be largely the same content in two places.
No in-person base or classes found (live group meditation is on Zoom/Skype), so availability is worldwide; Insight Timer lists Florida, USA, but no city.
Insight Timer handle is 'crystallizeddivinity'; Facebook page is titled 'Heart Revitalization - Jordyn Roe'.
left_out: Live group meditation class: no own URL (email enquiry only).
Teachable 'Revive the inner dialogue of self-love' link redirects to the Teachable home page, so not a separate offering.
